newsitem.title: INDIA: Popley Gold Plaza to sell gold coins to mark freedom.
newsitem.headline: Popley Gold Plaza to sell gold coins to mark freedom.

text.p: Popley Gold Plaza, a city jeweller, said it will issue gold coins to mark 50 years of Indian independence on behalf of the state-run MMTC Ltd.
"We will be selling gold coins to commemorate 50 years of Indian independence," a company spokesman said.
He said coins weighing 10 grammes, 24 carats, .999 purity, will be sold at 5,800 rupees each. Stocks are expected to reach the firm in the next few days, the spokesman said.
"Those interested to buy can book with us," he said.
